class.name: Keypad
class.lead: {@code Keypad} function provides support for keypad control.
class.description:
{@code Keypad} function provides support for keypad control. The keypad typically consists of one or more keys/buttons, which can be discerned. Different types of key presses like short and long press can typically also be detected. Each key pressed event is followed by a key released event. It's not possible to have two consecutive key pressed or key released events. There is only one eventable property and no operations.
{@code Keypad} can enumerate all supported keys in the key property metadata, {@link PropertyMetadata#getEnumValues(String)}.

field.name: PROPERTY_KEY
field.lead: Specifies a property name for a key from the keypad.
field.description: Specifies a property name for a key from the keypad. The property is eventable.

field.name: LIGHT
field.description:
The function type is applicable to:
{@code MultiLevelControl} - indicates that the {@code MultiLevelControl} can control light devices. Usually, such devices are called dimmable. {@code MultiLevelControl} minimum value can switch off the device and {@code MultiLevelControl} maximum value can increase the device light to the maximum possible value.
{@code MultiLevelSensor} - indicates that the sensor can monitor the light level.
{@code BooleanSensor} - indicates that the {@code BooleanSensor} can detected light. {@code true} state means that there is light. {@code false} state means that there is no light.
{@code BooleanControl} - indicates that there is a light device control. {@code true} state means that the light device will be turned on. {@code false} state means that the light device will be turned off.
This type can be specified as a value of {@link org.osgi.service.dal.Function#SERVICE_TYPE}.

{@code MultiLevelSensor} - indicates that the sensor can monitor the temperature.
This type can be specified as a value of {@link org.osgi.service.dal.Function#SERVICE_TYPE}.

class.name: WakeUp
class.lead: {@code WakeUp} function provides device awake monitoring.
class.description:
{@code WakeUp} function provides device awake monitoring. It's especially applicable to battery-operated devices. Such device can notify the system that it's awake and can receive commands with a {@link #PROPERTY_AWAKE} property event.
The device can periodically wake up for commands. The interval can be managed with {@link #PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL} property.

method.name: getWakeUpInterval
method.lead: Returns the current wake up interval.
method.description:
Returns the current wake up interval. It's a getter method for {@link #PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL} property. The device can periodically wake up and receive command based on this interval.
The interval can be measured in different units like hours, minutes, seconds, etc. The unit is specified in {@code LevelData} instance.
method.return: The current wake up interval.
method.throws: If this function service object has already been unregistered.
If an operation error is available.

method.name: setWakeUpInterval
method.lead: Sets wake up interval according to the specified unit.
method.description: Sets wake up interval according to the specified unit. It's a setter method for {@link #PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL} property. The device can periodically wake up and receive command based on this interval. The unit can be {@code null}, then the interval is measured in milliseconds.
method.param: The new wake up interval.
The interval unit. If the unit is {@code null}, the interval is measured in milliseconds.
method.throws: If this function service object has already been unregistered.
If an operation error is available.
If there is an invalid argument.

field.name: PROPERTY_AWAKE
field.lead: Specifies the awake property name.
field.description:
Specifies the awake property name. The property access type can be {@link PropertyMetadata#ACCESS_EVENTABLE}. If the device is awake, it will trigger a property event.
The property value type is {@code BooleanData}. The boolean data is always {@code true}. It marks that the device is awake.

field.name: PROPERTY_WAKE_UP_INTERVAL
field.lead: Specifies the wake up interval.
field.description: Specifies the wake up interval. The device can periodically wake up and receive commands. That interval is managed by this eventable property. The current property value is available with {@link #getWakeUpInterval()} and can be modified with {@link #setWakeUpInterval(BigDecimal, String)}.

class.name: AlarmData
class.description: Function alarm data. It cares about the alarm type, severity, timestamp and additional metadata. It doesn't support unit. The alarm type is mapped to {@code FunctionData} value.

method.name: AlarmData
method.lead: Constructs new {@code AlarmData} instance with the specified field values.
method.description:
Constructs new {@code AlarmData} instance with the specified field values. The map keys must match to the field names. The map values will be assigned to the appropriate class fields. For example, the maps can be: {"severity"=Integer(1)...}. That map will initialize the {@link #FIELD_SEVERITY} field with 1. If severity is missing, {@link #SEVERITY_UNDEFINED} is used.
{@link #FIELD_SEVERITY} - optional field. The value type must be {@code Integer}.
{@link #FIELD_TYPE} - optional field. The value type must be {@code Integer}.
method.param: Contains the new {@code AlarmData} instance field values.
method.throws: If the field value types are not expected.
If the alarm severity is invalid.
If the fields map is {@code null}.

method.name: AlarmData
method.lead: Constructs new {@code AlarmData} instance with the specified arguments.
method.description: Constructs new {@code AlarmData} instance with the specified arguments.
method.param: The alarm data timestamp optional field.
The alarm data metadata optional field.
The alarm data severity optional field.
The alarm data type optional field.
method.throws: If the alarm severity is invalid.

method.name: getType
method.lead: Returns the alarm type.
method.return: The alarm type.

method.name: getSeverity
method.lead: Returns the alarm severity.
method.return: The alarm severity.

method.name: equals
method.lead: Two {@code AlarmData} instances are equal if they contain equal metadata, timestamp, type and severity.
method.description: Two {@code AlarmData} instances are equal if they contain equal metadata, timestamp, type and severity.
method.param: The object to compare this data.
method.return: {@code true} if this object is equivalent to the specified one.

method.name: hashCode
method.lead: Returns the hash code for this {@code AlarmData} object.
method.description: Returns the hash code for this {@code AlarmData} object. The hash code is a sum of {@link FunctionData#hashCode()}, the alarm severity and the alarm type.
method.return: The hash code of this {@code AlarmData} object.

method.name: compareTo
method.lead: Compares this {@code AlarmData} instance with the given argument.
method.description:
Compares this {@code AlarmData} instance with the given argument. If the argument is not {@code AlarmData}, it throws {@code ClassCastException}. Otherwise, this method returns:
{@code -1} if this instance field is less than a field of the specified argument.
{@code 0} if all fields are equivalent.
{@code 1} if this instance field is greater than a field of the specified argument.
The fields are compared in this order: timestamp, metadata, type, severity.
method.param: {@code AlarmData} to be compared.
method.return: {@code -1}, {@code 0} or {@code 1} depending on the comparison rules.
method.throws: If the method argument is not of type {@code AlarmData}.

method.name: toString
method.lead: Returns the string representation of this alarm data.
method.description: Returns the string representation of this alarm data.
method.return: The string representation of this alarm data.
